Sturges' rule gives 6 bins with a bin width of about 12.67 for the histogram. Skewness near 0 means the distribution is essentially symmetric.
map.偏度与峰度怎么看？: How do you read skewness and kurtosis?
map.偏度=0 表示对称，>0 右偏（长尾在右），<0 左偏；本工具采用样本标准差计算: Skewness=0 means symmetric, >0 right-skewed (long tail right), <0 left-skewed; this tool uses the sample standard deviation. Kurtosis is excess kurtosis: 0 is approximately normal, >0 more peaked, <0 flatter.
map.分组数（bins）如何确定？: How is the number of bins determined?
map.留空时按 Sturges 规则 k=⌈log₂n+1⌉ 自动分组；样本量越大分组: When left blank, bins follow Sturges' rule k=⌈log₂n+1⌉ automatically; larger samples need more bins. You can also specify the bin count manually to suit display needs.
